descriptions.zh:
在调用该接口前，需要在POM文件添加以下依赖：

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.aliyun</groupId>
    <artifactId>aliyun-java-sdk-schedulerx2</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.5</version>
</dependency>
```
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, add the following dependency to your POM file:

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.aliyun</groupId>
    <artifactId>aliyun-java-sdk-schedulerx2</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.5</version>
</dependency>
```

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 list-groups --namespace 1a72ecb1-b4cc-400a-a71b-20cdec9b0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-group-name k8s-test --region cn-hangzhou
